button.summary: Primary (ink), secondary (raised), ghost and destructive; three sizes; icon, loading, selected, disabled.

text_field.summary: One-line field and search field on the well material; label, help, error, prefix, suffix, clear.

select.summary: One choice of a few: a well trigger over rune-kit's listbox behaviour, the list on the floating material.

switch.summary: A well track that fills with ink when on, a floating thumb; with words the whole line is the control.

segmented.summary: A well track holding one raised segment; concentric radii; icons optional.

chip.summary: Tags (quiet tint) and filter chips (raised, lifted; selected stays down); removable.

badge.summary: Counts, dots and status pills: a meaning's wash, a dot and words.

card.summary: Slab and raised cards, rows split by inset hairlines, a section header, a divider.
